test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 08
subject: general
question: Eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing each other for a lunch. A is opposite F and third to the right of B. G is between F and D.H is to the left of D. E is between C and A. Who is sitting third to the right of C?
solution:
Arranging them according to the given information,

A is opposite F and third to the right of B.

G is between F and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45f21d3cb1c73d6c9f4ddd0c8b92d2e354918567eef994420968f2d0065d8541.png] 

H is to the left of D.

E is between C and A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4346037b146d6971cc6a222305b9fcfb5d1b974af2ab62f6fc2ec52f8f0e1cb0.png] 

H sitting third to the right of C.

Hence, “H” is the correct answer.
